lines.zh: 我在院子里转两圈，活动筋骨。
lines.en: I take a couple of turns round the yard to loosen up.
This part needs fixing. I'll note it.

lines.zh: 我走过去，看看门有没有关好。
lines.en: I walk over to check the door is shut.
My feet on the flagstones. Solid.

lines.zh: 走一圈就回来，我不走远。
lines.en: One lap and back. I don't go far.

lines.zh: 我把箱子挪到墙边，省地方。
lines.en: I shift the crate to the wall to save space.
The grass in the yard has gotten tall.
I pace by the door, waiting for someone.
I walk this path every day.

lines.zh: 走两步就停，怕错过访客。
lines.en: Two steps, then a pause — I might miss a visitor.
I go round to look behind the house.

lines.zh: 脚尖踢到石头，差点绊倒。
lines.en: My toe caught a stone; nearly tripped.
Back to sit down. My legs ache a bit.
I carry the firewood over to the stove.

lines.zh: 我就站在这，等有人来问。
lines.en: I'll stand here in case someone comes asking.
Quiet yard. That's fine.
I lean on the doorframe and rest.

lines.zh: 今天的活儿，差不多干完了。
lines.en: Today's work is mostly done.

lines.zh: 我看看手上的老茧，笑了笑。
lines.en: I look at my calluses and smile.

lines.zh: 有人来问路，我就带他去。
lines.en: If someone needs directions, I'll show them.
I've been in this place many years.

lines.zh: 我把袖子挽好，随时能干活。
lines.en: Sleeves rolled. Ready to work.

lines.zh: 远处有动静，我抬头看看。
lines.en: Something stirs in the distance; I look up.
The sun's moved. Time to think about dinner.
I'm not good at doing nothing.
The road outside runs east.

lines.zh: 我打了个哈欠，又忍住了。
lines.en: I yawn, then suppress it.
I'll be right here. Not going anywhere.

lines.zh: 你来了，我等你一会儿了。
lines.en: There you are. I've been waiting.
If you need to know something, just ask.
I know the look of a traveler.
Sit first; talking on your feet is tiring.

lines.zh: 这附近的事，我基本都知道。
lines.en: I know most of what happens around here.
You're carrying a fair amount.
No need for ceremony. I don't charge.

lines.zh: 你看上去累了，歇一歇吧。
lines.en: You look tired. Rest a while.
Take your time. I'm not busy.
I know the roads. I can point you.

lines.zh: 你要是惹了麻烦，我不掺和。
lines.en: If you've brought trouble, I'll stay out of it.
Sit. Let me pour you some water.
Head east on this road. Don't stray.
At my age, I can't fight anymore.
Here for news? Sit down.
Don't stand in the doorway. Come in.
Hey, stop — these old bones.
I brace on the wall and catch my breath.
The damage to the place. What a waste.
I'm on the ground and can't get up.

lines.zh: 我一个干活的，挡不住几下。
lines.en: I'm a working man; I can't take many hits.
That was my ribs.
Cool down. Let's talk.
There's blood on my face. I wipe it.
I'm alive. Don't panic.
A couple of days' rest will fix this.
Put it on the table. I'll eat shortly.

lines.zh: 你带的东西，我不能白拿。
lines.en: I can't take your food for nothing.

lines.zh: 多少年没人给我带吃的了。
lines.en: No one's brought me food in years.
This is good. Thank you.
Half is plenty for me.

lines.zh: 留着路上吃吧，你更需要。
lines.en: Save it for the road. You need it more.
Let me try it. Just one bite.

lines.zh: 这么客气，我倒不好意思。
lines.en: So generous — now I'm embarrassed.
Sit there and eat with me.

lines.zh: 下次别带东西，人来就行。
lines.en: Next time just come. No need to bring things.
Oof, we bumped. You all right?
I'm old. I don't stand too steady.
The doorway's narrow. Let's squeeze through.

lines.zh: 你扶着点墙，别碰倒东西。
lines.en: Brace on the wall. Don't knock things over.
I'll step back. You go first.

lines.zh: 踩到我的脚了，不过没事。
lines.en: That was my foot, but it's fine.

lines.zh: 这院子里东西多，走路当心。
lines.en: Lot of things in this yard. Mind your step.

lines.zh: 别急，撞翻了我还得收拾。
lines.en: Easy — if you knock it over I have to tidy up.
Let's just sidestep each other.
I catch you so you don't fall.

lines.zh: 这话，我这年纪不好接了。
lines.en: At my age, I hardly know how to answer that.
Sit down. Let's just talk.

lines.zh: 我年轻时也闯过不少祸。
lines.en: I got into plenty of trouble when I was young.

lines.zh: 你要是不嫌弃，多留几天。
lines.en: If you don't mind, stay a few days.

lines.zh: 这院子以后也归你看管。
lines.en: You can watch over this yard too, later.

lines.zh: 我没什么可给的，只有这些。
lines.en: I've little to give. Only this.

lines.zh: 有人一起吃饭，饭都香些。
lines.en: A meal tastes better with company.
Don't rush off. It's getting dark.

lines.zh: 我把西屋收拾出来给你住。
lines.en: I'll clear out the west room for you.
This place finally feels lived in.
Let me hold that while your hands are full.
That's the very thing I lost.
A shame to leave it on the ground.
I'll put it back in the crate.
This is heavy. Both hands.
You keep it. Don't hand it to me.
Who left this here?

lines.zh: 我把它靠在门边，方便拿。
lines.en: I lean it by the door so it's handy.

lines.zh: 东西要归置好，不然找不到。
lines.en: Things need putting away, or they're lost.
I dust it off and put it back where it was.
Why are you staring at me?
I won't fight. Hear me clearly.

lines.zh: 我一辈子没跟人红过脸。
lines.en: I've never come to blows with anyone.
About the mission, sit and talk.

lines.zh: 这院子里有孩子，别乱来。
lines.en: There are children in this yard. Don't start anything.
I've no weapon in my hands.
If you hit me, I won't hit back.
I'll call someone. Don't follow.
This doesn't seem like you.
Calm down. We've no quarrel.
I'll stay right here. Do as you see fit.
I back away, but I don't run.
If you really mean to strike, I won't stop you.

lines.zh: 这地方打起来，东西都毁了。
lines.en: If this turns into a fight, everything here breaks.

lines.zh: 我把手举起来，给你看清楚。
lines.en: I raise my hands so you can see them.
I'm old. I can't run.
Hear me out before you decide.

lines.zh: 这门我没锁，你随时能走。
lines.en: The door isn't locked. You can leave anytime.
I've been watching your hands.
Not here. Take it outside.
I don't hit. I only dodge.
I push you back to protect myself.

lines.zh: 住手，这里不是你撒野的地方。
lines.en: Stop. This isn't a place for that.

lines.zh: 我抓住你的手腕，只是抓住。
lines.en: I catch your wrist. Only catch it.
Hit me again and I shout for help.
These hands are for working.

lines.zh: 你打我这把老骨头，值当吗？
lines.en: Is it worth hitting an old man?
I can't block many more. Stop.
I'm giving you a way out.
Don't make me call for help.
I'll be at the door, waiting for you.
Finally someone's come to this yard.
Come in. No need to stand on ceremony.

lines.zh: 我这把年纪，也不常动了。
lines.en: At my age I don't move around much.

lines.zh: 东西都归置好了，随便看。
lines.en: Everything's in order. Look around.
Ask me anything. I'm always here.
The tea's still hot. Sit.
Fine weather today.
The one I'm waiting for must be you.

lines.zh: 我在门口守着，等你说完。
lines.en: I keep the doorway and wait for you to finish.

lines.zh: 火燎了我的袖子，我扑灭了。
lines.en: Fire caught my sleeve. I put it out.

lines.zh: 从台阶上摔下去，疼得直哼。
lines.en: I fell down the steps and groaned.
I swallowed water and coughed for a while.

lines.zh: 炸得我耳朵嗡嗡响，站不稳。
lines.en: The blast left my ears ringing and my legs weak.

lines.zh: 这东西扎进我肩膀，动不了。
lines.en: It's stuck in my shoulder. I can't move it.
A flash of light and all my strength left.
I forgot to eat while working. My fault.

lines.zh: 我这把老骨头经不起雷。
lines.en: These old bones cannot take lightning.

lines.zh: 脚下空了，我抓不住东西。
lines.en: The ground vanished and there's nothing to grab.
